Morgantown
A Paw Palace in the Making
10 hours ago
Let’s raise the quality of life of Morgantown rescues by supporting Animal Friends’ new shelter. Animal Friends of North Central West Virginia has provided refuge for more than 10,000 unwanted, abandoned, and abused animals since 1999. But after a quarter century of sheltering and re-homing pets, the operation has outgrown its facility. “We are just constantly busting at the seams with new animals,” says Shelter Coordinator Katie Short. “There have been times I’ve had to say ‘No’—we’ve got the manpower and the will, but we don’t always have the space.” So the shelter is raising money for a 6,700-square-foot building with modern amenities for both dogs and cats.
